posts.name: dpt
posts.cooked:
I was just looking at the art for Inspiring Supertonic again. It shows Mr. Fixer punching a figure that looks like Baron Blade (with a green energy ball from Argent Adept's power), but the Baron Blade appears to be a mechanical golem:

  • BB's head is coming off, which sounds fatal, but we know (eg from the Tactics Kickstarter) that BB continues around.
  • There appear to be some wires dangling from the head, and other metal bits.

Any thoughts on what's going on? The flavor text is from "Burying the Blade #5".

Hmm, maybe the Tactics BB is actually a golem himself! The Kickstarter update says that he was left a "drained and broken man", but the image there sure doesn't look like it. But note the BB that Mr. Fixer is punching doesn't have the tech gauntlet yet.
